blockingIssues.problem: The title asserts that 25 grants have been awarded. The source states only that a draft proposes 25 awards and explicitly that no awards have been made; applications are not open and awards are conditional on approval.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "The board has published a draft; applications are not open. If approved in March, applications would open in May. The draft proposes 25 awards; no awards have been made."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source only supports that the draft proposes 25 awards and that no awards have been made; it does not support any statement that awards have already been awarded.
